svg.title: The scanner on one line of gcd.mote
svg.text: line 4 of gcd.mote, a character to a cell, with its column
the tokens so far, as --tokens prints them

g.title: w is a letter, so name() takes the whole word, while, and then finds it among the keywords: a keyword, at 4:1.
The space only keeps tokens apart: it is passed over. i is a word but not a keyword: a name, at 4:7.
! is not a digit, a letter or _, so op() tries the operators, the two-character ones first: != is one token, at 4:9.
Another space, then j: a name, at 4:12.
do: a keyword, at 4:14, the last token of the line.
The line end is passed over too: the line goes to 5 and the column back to 1. Nothing of the spaces or the line end is kept; the next token is if, at 5:5.
